maintenance.name: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Crash recovery, database check, local logs and their export. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.

updates.name: Updates
updates.description: Checks for a new signed version when you ask (or at start, if you turn that on) and installs it only after you confirm.

log_level.label: Log detail
log_level.description: How much the app writes to its local log file.

log_max_kb.label: Log file size (KiB)
log_max_kb.description: The log starts a new file at this size.

log_files.label: Old log files kept
log_files.description: How many older log files are kept before the oldest is deleted.

check_after_crash.label: Check the database after a crash
check_after_crash.description: When the app did not close normally, check the collection for damage at the next start.

check_on_start.label: Check for updates at start
check_on_start.description: Off by default: the app contacts the update server only when you ask.

logs.export: Export logs for a bug report

validation.draft_key: This draft name is not valid.
validation.draft_too_large: This draft is too large to keep.

conflict.update_not_available: There is no update to install. Check for updates first.
conflict.update_not_ready: The update has not been downloaded yet.

provider.update_network: The update server could not be reached. Try again later.
provider.update_signature: The downloaded update is not signed with this app's key, so it was refused.

app_maintenance.no_log: Logging to a file is off in this build.

logs.save_prompt: Where should the log bundle be saved?
